001package com.streamconverter.pmd.command;
002
003import com.streamconverter.command.AbstractStreamCommand;
004import com.streamconverter.pmd.PmdViolation;
005import java.io.EOFException;
006import java.io.IOException;
007import java.io.InputStream;
008import java.io.ObjectInputStream;
009import java.io.OutputStream;
010import java.nio.charset.StandardCharsets;
011import java.time.Instant;
012import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
013import java.util.Map;
014import java.util.TreeMap;
015
016/**
017 * {@link PmdViolation} オブジェクトのストリームを AI 可読性の高い Markdown 形式に変換するコマンド。
018 *
019 * <p>入力: {@link PmdXmlToViolationsCommand} が出力する {@link java.io.ObjectOutputStream} ストリーム
020 *
021 * <p>出力: Markdown レポート（ルール別統計・ファイル別統計・優先度分布）
022 *
023 * <p>違反オブジェクトは1件読むたびにカウントに加算して捨てるため、件数によらずカウント用の Map のみメモリに保持する。
024 */
025public class PmdXmlToMarkdownCommand extends AbstractStreamCommand {
026
027  @Override
028  public void execute(InputStream input, OutputStream output) throws IOException {
029    Stats stats = collectStats(input);
030    String report = generateMarkdownReport(stats);
031    output.write(report.getBytes(StandardCharsets.UTF_8));
032  }
033
034  private Stats collectStats(InputStream input) throws IOException {
035    Stats stats = new Stats();
036    try (ObjectInputStream ois = new ObjectInputStream(input)) {
037      while (true) {
038        try {
039          PmdViolation v = (PmdViolation) ois.readObject();
040          stats.totalViolations++;
041          stats.ruleCount.merge(v.rule(), new RuleStat(v.ruleset(), 1L), RuleStat::add);
042          stats.fileCount.merge(v.file(), 1L, Long::sum);
043          stats.priorityCount.merge(v.priority(), 1L, Long::sum);
044        } catch (EOFException e) {
045          break;
046        } catch (ClassNotFoundException | ClassCastException e) {
047          throw new IOException("Unexpected object type in stream: expected PmdViolation", e);
048        }
049      }
050    }
051    return stats;
052  }
053
054  private String generateMarkdownReport(Stats stats) {
055    StringBuilder md = new StringBuilder();
056    md.append("# PMD Code Quality Analysis Report\n\n");
057    md.append("**Generated**: ").append(Instant.now()).append("\n");
058    md.append("**Total Violations**: ").append(stats.totalViolations).append("\n\n");
059
060    generateTopRulesSection(md, stats);
061    generateFileStatisticsSection(md, stats);
062    generatePriorityDistributionSection(md, stats);
063
064    return md.toString();
065  }
066
067  private void generateTopRulesSection(StringBuilder md, Stats stats) {
068    md.append("## \uD83C\uDFAF Top Code Smell Rules\n\n");
069    md.append("| Rank | Rule | Count | Category |\n");
070    md.append("|------|------|-------|----------|\n");
071
072    int[] rank = {1};
073    stats.ruleCount.entrySet().stream()
074        .sorted(
075            Map.Entry.<String, RuleStat>comparingByValue((a, b) -> Long.compare(b.count, a.count)))
076        .limit(20)
077        .forEach(
078            entry ->
079                md.append(
080                    String.format(
081                        "| %d | %s | %d | %s |\n",
082                        rank[0]++,
083                        entry.getKey(),
084                        entry.getValue().count,
085                        entry.getValue().category)));
086  }
087
088  private void generateFileStatisticsSection(StringBuilder md, Stats stats) {
089    md.append("\n## \uD83D\uDCC1 Files with Most Issues\n\n");
090    md.append("| File | Violations |\n");
091    md.append("|------|------------|\n");
092
093    stats.fileCount.entrySet().stream()
094        .sorted(Map.Entry.<String, Long>comparingByValue().reversed())
095        .limit(15)
096        .forEach(
097            entry ->
098                md.append(
099                    String.format(
100                        "| %s | %d |\n",
101                        entry.getKey().replaceAll(".*/(\\w+\\.java)", "$1"), entry.getValue())));
102  }
103
104  private void generatePriorityDistributionSection(StringBuilder md, Stats stats) {
105    md.append("\n## \u26A1 Priority Distribution\n\n");
106    md.append("| Priority | Count | Description |\n");
107    md.append("|----------|-------|-------------|\n");
108
109    stats.priorityCount.forEach(
110        (priority, count) -> {
111          String desc =
112              switch (priority) {
113                case 1 -> "\uD83D\uDD34 High - Critical issues";
114                case 2 -> "\uD83D\uDFE1 Medium - Important issues";
115                case 3 -> "\uD83D\uDFE2 Low - Minor issues";
116                case 4 -> "\u2139\uFE0F Info - Informational";
117                default -> "\u2753 Unknown";
118              };
119          md.append(String.format("| %d | %d | %s |\n", priority, count, desc));
120        });
121  }
122
123  private static class Stats {
124    int totalViolations = 0;
125    final Map<String, RuleStat> ruleCount = new LinkedHashMap<>();
126    final Map<String, Long> fileCount = new LinkedHashMap<>();
127    final Map<Integer, Long> priorityCount = new TreeMap<>();
128  }
129
130  private record RuleStat(String category, long count) {
131    static RuleStat add(RuleStat a, RuleStat b) {
132      return new RuleStat(a.category, a.count + b.count);
133    }
134  }
135}
